readings.meaning: SIP call or VoIP internet telephony

reasoning: Shows a telephone handset with the acronym 'SIP' (Session Initiation Protocol), specifically representing VoIP and internet telephony tasks. While recognizable to IT admins and power users configuring PBX systems or softphones, for general users it is too niche and easily confused with a standard phone call icon at small sizes.
